description: We are SpaceNasa26, a team of enthusiastic college students interested in space science, technology, innovation, and problem-solving. We aim to develop creative solutions using NASA data. We welcome members interested in programming, electronics, AI, data analysis, agriculture, and creative design.
summary: Our project, AgriPulse – NASA Satellite-Based Smart Farming and Crop Stress Prediction System, aims to help farmers make better agricultural decisions using NASA Earth observation data and Artificial Intelligence. The system uses NASA satellite and climate datasets to monitor rainfall, temperature, soil moisture, and environmental changes affecting agricultural fields. AI-based analysis helps identify potential crop stress and changing weather conditions. The platform provides a simple dashboard to visualize agricultural data and offers useful insights to support farmers in planning irrigation and crop management. This project aims to promote climate-smart agriculture, reduce crop losses, and encourage sustainable farming practices.
details: AgriPulse is a smart farming project that uses NASA satellite data to help farmers. It monitors rainfall, temperature, and soil moisture. The system uses AI to analyze environmental data and identify possible crop problems. A simple dashboard displays the information and helps farmers make better decisions about irrigation and crop management. The main aim is to reduce crop losses, save water, and support sustainable agriculture
